analyses.content: 录音中提到这种植物会“take over a whole garden”，直接对应题目中的“take over a _________”，因此填入 garden。
注意听清连读，你可能只听到了“whole”而忽略了后面的核心名词“garden”，一定要结合句子完整语义去抓取名词。
As many of you have noticed in your own life, some of these species outcompetes other plants and take over a whole garden.
录音明确说到物种被“humans or birds”带出并在之后带入新环境，题目已有 birds，因此对应填入 humans。
题目结构是“birds and ___”，而录音中是“humans or birds”，你需要识别出这种并列关系的替换，不要因为没听到“and”就漏抓答案。
These species are often brought out of their native range by humans or birds. They unknowingly carry the seeds with them to a new environment.
录音中说到该植物“native to Western and Central Europe”，“native to”直接替换了题干的“Originally from”。
录音中出现了“Western and Central”作为修饰语，但本题只要求填 ONE WORD ONLY，你需要抓准最终的核心地点名词 Europe。
Common broom, or Scotch broom, is a plant native to Western and Central Europe.
听到“commodity industry”定位后，紧接着录音提到“responsible for the lost timber production”，“lost”对应题干的“decrease”，填入 timber。
句子后半段跟着一长串经济数据（如1500万美金），你不要被这些数字干扰，死死盯住直接修饰“production”的名词即可。
It even affected the performance of the commodity industry. It is estimated that it is responsible for the lost timber production, which was worth fifteen million US dollars last year in Oregon.
录音明示“biological control, like introducing some insects”，“like”对应题目的“such as”，直接得出 insects。
听写时要注意名词的复数尾音“s”，这种细节没听清极容易导致拼写错误从而丢分。
Another way is biological control, like introducing some insects from its place of origin.
录音提到“brought to America from Russia in nineteen seventy-five”，“brought to”替换了“introduced to”，直接得出源头国家 Russia。
同一句话里同时出现了 America 和 Russia，你需要根据题干的“from”准确分辨出表示来源的地点是 Russia。
This species was brought to America from Russia in nineteen seventy-five, and it is now widely seen throughout the US.
听到录音描述“yellow flowers and bears bright red fruits”，根据题目给出的颜色线索 yellow，锁定对应的名词 flowers。
紧接着出现了干扰信息“red fruits”，你不要因为注意力滞后或没看清题目要求的颜色而误填为 fruits。
It has yellow flowers and bears bright red fruits.
录音描述叶子特征为“smooth, dark green leaves”，直接对应题目中与 dark green 并列的形容词 smooth。
在两个形容词连续修饰一个名词时，第一个词发音往往比较快，你需要紧跟主语“leaves”抓取前面的所有修饰语。
It has smooth, dark green leaves.
录音指出鸟类将种子带去很远的地方“along their path of migration”，填入表示鸟类行为活动的 migration 契合题意。
听到“path”时你可能就急着下笔了，但题干“birds' ___”要求填入的是鸟类的一种特定行为，且后半句的“migration”才是这一语义块的真正落脚点。
Buckthorn can spread widely with the help of birds that eat its fruits. They then carry the seeds long distances along their path of migration.
录音中在对比 sea buckthorn 时提到“used to treat serious digestive problems”，“treat”直接替换了“treatment”，填入修饰 problems 的 digestive。
这是一个较长的学术词汇，发音可能会让你短暂卡壳，你需要根据读音规律迅速拼写，并注意别把前后的修饰词跟核心名词搞混。
It is different from sea buckthorn, which is a plant that can be used to treat serious digestive problems.
